harness.note: the real machine code of the functions named, over a world built from the real command table; presentation, queue and sound calls replaced by recorders.

description: The user's CTB rank and recovery after an Overdrive: the rank stored when the action is first calculated, the minigame result with a Fail, a success or an (Immune) row, and the recovery the action-done call adds to the counter.
notes: in.cmd is the id of the Overdrive command record the player chose (0x3060 Spiral Cut, 0x3061 Slice and Dice, 0x3062 Energy Rain, 0x3063 Blitz Ace; 0x3064 Shooting Star, 0x3065 Dragon Fang, 0x3066 Banishing Blade, 0x3067 Tornado); in.user is the character id (0 Tidus, 2 Auron); in.grade is the quality the controller passes (0 a Fail, 1 a success).
in.agi is the user's agility, in.haste and in.slow are the counters Chr+0x613 and Chr+0x614; the user's counter starts at 0, so out.ctb is the recovery the action-done call added (clamped to a byte).

out.rankFirst is Chr+0xDE8 after the first calculation (0x7892E0), out.rankAfter the same byte after the minigame result (0x7B0470 / 0x7AFE00): they are equal in every vector, because the result handler never writes it. out.variant is the variant byte of the target's result record after the handler: 0 the Fail row, 1 the success row, 2 an (Immune) row.

class table holds the rank byte (Cmd+0x24) of the eight menu rows and of the replacement rows (0x30EB to 0x30ED the Fail rows of the Swordplay moves, 0x310A to 0x310D the Bushido Fail rows, 0x310E to 0x3111 the (Immune) rows, 0x3112 the finisher); the replacement rows' ranks never reach the user.

class immune: the target is written so that the first pass inflicts none of the move's riders (in.target: extraImmune 0x100 for Shooting Star, delayImmune 255 for Dragon Fang, all four Break bytes 255 for Banishing Blade).
name: overdrive_rank
